target: RMUC2027 central tower, current synthetic map asset

source_policy.projection_aid: may be used only as a visual aid after checking visibility/occlusion; must be marked in geometry.reference_source and never treated as independent truth
source_policy.split_label: each frame carries group_id and exposure state; the split field must not claim sealed_test for already exposed data
source_policy.independent_annotation: preferred: >=2 human annotators with adjudication; a single agent proxy annotation is allowed only with annotator.annotator_type=AGENT_PROXY and review_status recording its limit

units_and_coordinates.bbox: xywh, source-image pixels, origin top-left, no normalization in source labels
units_and_coordinates.keypoint: source-image pixels (x, y) and boolean visible; not normalized
units_and_coordinates.candidates: source-image pixels, same convention as bbox/keypoint
units_and_coordinates.model_export: normalization happens only in the exporter; letterbox scale/pad must be recorded

bbox_scope.rule: axis-aligned box of the visible target object itself = head/top light-rack plus tapering body (and, if present and attached to the tower, its stepped base pedestal); clipping at image borders is mandatory
includes: head and its two arms / top light rack
attached stepped base pedestal that is visually part of the tower
excludes: unrelated structures (walls, benches, robots, lamp posts)
bbox_scope.truncation: for a truncated frame the bbox covers ONLY the part visible inside the image; clip at the border; never extrapolate an off-frame extent; set target.truncated=true
bbox_scope.compatibility: NOT compatible with the v1-era boxes that included the arena platform: measured median height difference 37 px (n=18, blind vs old). Do not mix these conventions in one training/evaluation label set.

fields.source: {run, family, group_id, generation, sequence, split, origin_split_in_freeze}
fields.source.group_id: physical trajectory/reset/static near-identical frames share one group_id; required for grouped splitting
fields.target.landmark_id: proposed stable ID such as RMUC2027_CENTRAL_TOWER_PROPOSED
fields.target.undecidable: boolean; true only when presence itself cannot be settled; use instead of writing uncertainty into present=false
fields.target.visibility: FULL | PARTIAL | OCCLUDED | ABSENT | UNKNOWN (see visibility and truncation rules)
fields.target.truncated: boolean; any part of the target structure falls outside the image bounds
fields.target.occluded: boolean; target hidden by another object/structure (frame-edge cutting is NOT occlusion)
fields.target.ambiguous: boolean; target identity/multiple similar structures uncertain
fields.target.undecidable_reason: SIMILAR_STRUCTURE_CANDIDATE | IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED | OCCLUSION | IMAGE_QUALITY | ANNOTATOR_UNDECIDABLE; required when undecidable=true
fields.geometry.bbox_xywh: pixels, origin top-left; required for present targets except full OCCLUDED where the object is not directly visible
fields.geometry.keypoint: {name: green_roof_light_center, x, y, visible}; null when the reference point is not visible; never guess
fields.geometry.reference_unavailable_reason: REFERENCE_OCCLUDED | REFERENCE_OUT_OF_FRAME | REFERENCE_TOO_SMALL | REFERENCE_NOT_PRESENT | ANNOTATOR_UNDECIDABLE; required when reference_status=UNAVAILABLE
fields.geometry.reference_source: MANUAL_VISUAL | COLOR_CUE_ASSISTED | PROJECTION_AID | TEMPLATE_ANCHOR | NOT_APPLICABLE; records how the reference point was obtained (independence disclosure)
fields.candidates: list of competing structures: {candidate_id, bbox_xywh|null, keypoint|null, green_cue|null, source: ANNOTATOR|COLOR_CUE, note}; required when ambiguous=true or negative_type in {SIMILAR_STRUCTURE, OTHER_LANDMARK}
fields.negative_type: TARGET_ABSENT | SIMILAR_STRUCTURE | OTHER_LANDMARK | NONE (strict enum); must be null when present=true or undecidable=true
fields.annotator.independent_of_model_dev: boolean; false when the annotator is also the model/algorithm developer for this task
fields.annotator.independent_of_detector_cue: boolean; false when the reference point comes from the same colour cue used by the detector
fields.pixel_basis: {image_width, image_height, fx_px, cx_px, cy_px, projection_model: PINHOLE, bearing_formula}; must match the image dimensions
fields.notes: free text; must explain ambiguous/undecidable judgements
fields.target.full_occlusion_note: present=true + visibility=OCCLUDED + no bbox is allowed; such a GT frame is labelled GT_UNOBSERVABLE for detection metrics

presence_states.geometry: bbox required; keypoint per reference rules

presence_states.meaning: presence cannot be decided (e.g. similar structure candidate)
presence_states.geometry: no bbox/keypoint; negative_type must be null; undecidable_reason required; visibility=UNKNOWN; reference_status=NOT_APPLICABLE; excluded from BOTH positive and negative denominators and reported separately as UNDECIDABLE

definitions.FULL: whole target object visible, no frame-edge cut, no occlusion
definitions.PARTIAL: target object visible but either frame-edge cut or partly hidden by another object
definitions.OCCLUDED: target fully hidden behind another object; not directly visible
definitions.ABSENT: target not in the scene (confirmed absent)
definitions.UNKNOWN: visibility cannot be judged; only allowed together with undecidable=true

precedence: 1. full occlusion -> visibility=OCCLUDED, occluded=true, keypoint=null, reference_status=UNAVAILABLE, reference_unavailable_reason=REFERENCE_OCCLUDED
2. partial visibility caused by another object -> visibility=PARTIAL, occluded=true, truncated=false (unless also cut)
3. partial visibility caused by frame edge -> visibility=PARTIAL, truncated=true, occluded=false
4. frame edge cut AND in-scene occlusion -> visibility=PARTIAL, truncated=true, occluded=true; occlusion is the primary reason, both flags stay set
5. fully inside frame and fully visible -> visibility=FULL, truncated=false, occluded=false
frame-edge cutting is never described as occlusion, and truncation is never hidden inside visibility alone
constraints: occluded=true requires visibility PARTIAL or OCCLUDED

reference_rules.visible: keypoint.visible=true, reference_status=MANUAL_APPROX, reference_source records the method
reference_rules.hidden: keypoint=null, reference_status=UNAVAILABLE, reference_unavailable_reason required; do not guess
reference_rules.circularity_guard: if reference_source is COLOR_CUE_ASSISTED or TEMPLATE_ANCHOR and the same cue is used by the detector, the anchor error is NOT independent evidence; report annotator.independent_of_detector_cue=false and say so

ambiguity_rules.set_ambiguous: any unresolved target identity or multiple similar structures
ambiguity_rules.candidates: list every competing structure with bbox or green_cue and source; >=1 candidate when ambiguous=true; >=2 when ambiguous_reason=MULTIPLE_SIMILAR_STRUCTURES
ambiguity_rules.keypoint: never emit a guessed keypoint for an ambiguous frame
ambiguity_rules.training: ambiguous frames are excluded from identity-positive training by default; keep them as explicit difficult examples
ambiguity_rules.downstream: V2.2 section 7.6 requires multi-hypothesis retention; candidates[] is the transport for it

negative_rules.SIMILAR_STRUCTURE: confirmed target absent but a similar-looking structure exists; candidates must record it so a green-seeded detector FP can be counted against the label
negative_rules.OTHER_LANDMARK: the visible structure is a different landmark; record it in candidates
negative_rules.TARGET_ABSENT: confirmed absent with no competing structure to record
negative_rules.NONE: only for internal consistency checks; not a usable negative label

annotator_provenance.disclosure: AGENT_PROXY means an agent proxy annotation; it is not an expert or human independent review
annotator_provenance.preferred: HUMAN with HUMAN_REVIEWED/ADJUDICATED; >=2 independent annotators plus adjudication for any precision claim

pixel_basis.rule: record the actual intrinsics and image size used for the annotation; do not reuse intrinsics across resolutions
pixel_basis.bearing: image bearing = atan2(x_px - cx_px, fx_px); it is an image angle, not a world bearing and not a distance
pixel_basis.measured_scale: for the current 320x240 front RGB, fx=160, cx=160, cy=120: 1 px ~= 0.3581 deg near the optical axis; the green light core is 4-9 px wide (area 10-49 px) at 320x240, i.e. about 8-18 px wide after 2x letterbox to 640

mapping_rules: present + reference visible -> bbox + (kx, ky, v=1) after letterbox transform

present + reference invisible -> bbox + placeholder coordinate (bbox centre in model input) + v=0; the placeholder is never a reference estimate and v=0 frames are excluded from anchor/bearing/coverage denominators
present + visibility=OCCLUDED with no bbox -> no positive label (excluded; cannot train a box for an invisible object)
absent (present=false, undecidable=false) -> empty label file; the image must be listed explicitly in the dataset manifest (never silently dropped)
undecidable=true -> no positive label; excluded from both positive and negative denominators; reported separately
ambiguous=true -> no positive label by default; keep as explicit difficult example
truncated=true -> keep the box clipped at the image border; v per reference visibility; truncation itself must live in the sidecar
do not use v=2: this data cannot reliably distinguish visible/occluded/out-of-frame
derived_model_format.sidecar_reason: YOLO labels cannot carry truncation/occlusion/ambiguity/reference provenance; stratified reporting and FP attribution require the sidecar

required_checks: ambiguous requires candidates; candidates bounds and source enum
source split not mislabelled as sealed_test
quality_gate.sample_status: v2 example document validated in docs/reports/perception/annotation_verify_20261104/blind_pass/protocol/ (PASS); v2 is DRAFT and not yet used for a production label batch

denominator_rules.detection_fourfold: GT fully occluded (visibility=OCCLUDED, no bbox) or undecidable=true frames are excluded from TP/FP/FN/TN and counted separately as GT_UNOBSERVABLE
denominator_rules.gt_unobservable_vs_model_unknown: GT_UNOBSERVABLE is an annotation-side state; model-side UNKNOWN is a detector output. They must be reported as separate counts and never merged
denominator_rules.presence_and_joint: presence and joint reports must display the GT_UNOBSERVABLE count next to the fourfold
denominator_rules.keypoint_anchor: anchor/bearing denominators only include present frames with reference_status=MANUAL_APPROX (v=1 in export)
denominator_rules.keypoint_coverage: coverage denominator = present frames with reference_status=MANUAL_APPROX; frames with UNAVAILABLE reference are excluded and counted separately
denominator_rules.absent_negative_denominator: confirmed absent frames (negative_type in TARGET_ABSENT/SIMILAR_STRUCTURE/OTHER_LANDMARK) form the negative denominator; undecidable frames are not negatives
denominator_rules.ambiguous: ambiguous frames are excluded from identity-positive and from negative denominators by default; if kept, report separately

v1_to_v2_mapping.G5 competing candidates: candidates[] + target.ambiguous_reason; required for ambiguous and SIMILAR_STRUCTURE/OTHER_LANDMARK negatives
v1_to_v2_mapping.G6 negative_type enum: strict NEGATIVE_TYPES_V2; undecidable must not carry negative_type
v1_to_v2_mapping.G7 reference_status enum: strict enum + validator error (old free-text value now rejected)
